name: teaching-ghosts
description: Copilot-style ghost hints that coach the next step instead of writing code for you.

teachingGhosts.languages.description: Language IDs where Teaching Ghosts should appear. Use ["*"] to allow every language.

teachingGhosts.maxSuggestionLength.description: Maximum character length for each inline coaching chunk. Longer responses continue in later completions.

teachingGhosts.showStatusBar.description: Show the Teaching Ghosts status bar toggle.

teachingGhosts.provider.description: External direction provider. Configure an API key, or disable API-key requirements for a local no-auth endpoint.

teachingGhosts.baseUrl.description: Base URL for an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API. The extension appends /chat/completions unless it is already present.

teachingGhosts.model.description: Model name for the OpenAI-compatible provider.

teachingGhosts.apiKeyEnvVar.description: Environment variable to read before falling back to the API key stored in VS Code Secret Storage.

teachingGhosts.requireApiKey.description: Require an API key before making provider requests. Disable for local OpenAI-compatible endpoints that do not use authentication.

teachingGhosts.sendFullFileContext.description: Send the whole active file to the LLM provider. When disabled, only nearby lines are sent.

teachingGhosts.maxContextLines.description: Maximum nearby context lines to send when full-file context is disabled.

teachingGhosts.requestTimeoutMs.description: LLM request timeout in milliseconds. Timed-out requests show no suggestion.

teachingGhosts.responseTokenLimit.description: Maximum tokens to request from the LLM provider.

teachingGhosts.suggestionMode.description: Whether Teaching Ghosts may show automatic inline suggestions or only respond to manual invocation and commands.

teachingGhosts.automaticSuggestionDelayM.description: Quiet time before automatic suggestions are requested. Manual suggestions skip this delay.

teachingGhosts.llmTriggerMode.description: Whether LLM suggestions may appear automatically or only for manually invoked inline suggestions and commands.
